text_block_list.name: Sirius's Father
text_block_list.text:
And now, Sirius Symboli of our house shall perform a welcoming musical piece.
To all our esteemed guests in attendance...—
choice_data_list: (I-Is she really going to be okay...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her performance with bated breath.
It all started a few weeks ago—

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
...And that is the situation.
For you, Trainer, we request your presence at our family gathering. And for Sirius—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"A ‘welcome performance,’ huh.
Just tell them I'll play the violin or something."

text_block_list.name: Old Butler
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Well then, we shall be waiting for you at our family's commemorative party.
choice_data_list: A performance, huh... I'll need to set aside time to practice
A performance, huh... I'll need to set aside time to practice

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
URA bigwigs will be attending this gathering. We can't afford to fail.
I know it'll be tough balancing it alongside training, but...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: I don't need crap like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Don't tell me she's going in with no prep at all?
No, no... surely not—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heeey, hold it right thereee!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, they are furious.
Looks like they caught on to us playing mahjong in secret yesterday too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Haha, guess it can't be helped! Let's head outside until the dust settles.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No way—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Come on, get up.
You're good enough to hog the whole table, aren't you? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Self-proclaimed Pro-level Man
text_block_list.text:
Ghk...!
I'm sh-sho shorryyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Entourage
text_block_list.text:
She settled it in the blink of an eye...!
Awesome... That's Sirius-senpai for you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
choice_data_list: (Are you really, truly going to be okay...!?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she found even practicing to be a hassle in the first place,
why did she agree to perform the "welcome performance"?
While I was wondering about that—

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so much for waiting. Now then,
please enjoy this brief concert."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A powerful, provocative, and unwavering tone...
That melody was Sirius Symboli herself, taking complete control over even my breath.

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After Sirius Symboli's entertainment came to an end and the venue regained its composure...

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Hey, pup.
You're the host today, so mind your manners.
choice_data_list: Amazing! And you didn't even practice at all!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Believe it or not, I'm an ojou-sama, see. It was hammered into me back in the day as part of my etiquette training.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So for something of that level,
a quick review right beforehand will suffice.
choice_data_list: Did you learn any other ladylike arts?
Did you take lessons in any other ladylike arts?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So for something of that level,
a quick review right beforehand will suffice.
choice_data_list: Did you learn any other ladylike arts?
Did you take lessons in any other ladylike arts?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Piano, of course, along with flower arrangement and tea ceremony.
I even did fencing and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Everything you learn becomes a weapon of your own.
Studying's a pain in the neck, but it sure comes in handy.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Whoops, look who's arrived.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Heh heh, you really are a slow learner. Why bring that up now, of all times?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Well, fall for me all you want.
It only makes you easier to discipline, after all."

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Whoops, look who's arrived.

text_block_list.name: Overseas Racing Dignitary
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, Sirius Symboli-kun.
Thank you for that splendid performance earlier."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the visitor's face, tension suddenly washed over me.
They're easily one of the most prominent VIPs here today!

text_block_list.name: Overseas Racing Dignitary
text_block_list.text:
You gave it a French folk song arrangement midway through, didn't you?
What a clever touch.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Mr. C.B. to have noticed.
...By the way, the race held over there the other day developed quite unexpectedly, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Overseas Racing Dignitary
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! You were watching that?
Hmm, I would love to exchange thoughts, but
today is a bit inconvenient...

text_block_list.name: Overseas Racing Dignitary
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to set up a proper gathering at a later date.
Along with your Trainer over there, of course.
I'll be in touch again. Take care.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once the guest was out of sight,
I finally let out the breath I'd been holding in tension.
Pathetic as it was, I had basically been standing frozen stiff.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ――...That's quite a satisfactory result.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
"Did you really think I'd play the violin
just because someone asked me to?"

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Get this straight, pup.
...I don't lift a finger without a damn good reason.
